'''The destruction of TD-10036-EM-1271''' occurred when star [[TD-10036-EM-1271]] was destroyed in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]]. It was destroyed using [[Centerpoint Station]], then under the control of the [[Sacorrian Triad]].
